author: Arendeth
description: Golem Race: at Construction level 10 learn Golem Assembly, build an Assembly Cradle and perform it to become a golem. Golems never hunger, thirst or tire, wear no clothes, and use swappable golem parts (clay, stone, bronze, steel) in the head, torso, legs and both hand slots. Credits: Arendeth (design); built with Claude (Anthropic); Soulash 2 and core_2 by Wizards of the Code.
name: Golem Race
